name: Commanders run
notes: Four straight titles. QB unconfirmed: Sanchez's 4 rings fit, but Daniels and Gooden are also listed as Commanders.

name: Waller–Finney era
rival: Kyric McQuay's Colts beat you in LXXXI (Y22) and LXXXIII (Y24)

name: Bills dynasty
notes: Seven straight titles; nine straight counting the Bucs' last two. Baylon, John, Baugh and Lowe each have exactly 7 rings.

name: Ikarras era
notes: Ikarras's 9 rings match your 9 titles in this window. Every rushing record falls.

name: Brandson era
notes: Record passing numbers, 8 MVPs, playoff losses in CIX (Y50) and CXIX (Y60). 68–21 Super Bowl win in CXIV, the 94-TD season.

name: Vikings dynasty
notes: Johnson breaks Finney's career mark with Tyrion Kline's son beside him. The Wilson brothers likely at QB.

name: Modern era
notes: Titans three-peat, then a loss to those same Titans as the Seahawks in CXXXIII. One title in the last seven seasons.
